```{r}
#| include: false
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

df <- read_csv(here("data/processed/submissions_cleaned.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Metrics come from scripts/03_fetch_metrics.R, keyed on the software website.
# Entries without a row (or with NA fields) simply omit that metric.
metrics_path <- here("data/processed/package_metrics.csv")
if (file.exists(metrics_path)) {
  df <- left_join(df, read_csv(metrics_path, show_col_types = FALSE),
                  by = "Software website")
}
for (col in c("github_stars", "github_followers", "first_commit_date",
              "last_commit_date", "contributors", "cran_downloads_last_month",
              "cran_downloads_total")) {
  if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- NA
}

esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))

# Entries have no name field of their own, so derive one from the repository
# URL: github.com/owner/repo -> repo, owner.github.io/pkg -> pkg.
derive_name <- function(url) {
  if (is.na(url) || !nzchar(url)) return(NA_character_)
  u <- sub("/+$", "", sub("^https?://", "", url))
  parts <- strsplit(u, "/")[[1]]
  host <- parts[1]
  if (grepl("github\\.io$", host) && length(parts) >= 2) return(parts[2])
  if (identical(host, "github.com") && length(parts) >= 3) return(parts[3])
  if (length(parts) >= 2) return(parts[length(parts)])
  sub("\\..*$", "", host)
}

split_tags <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(character(0))
  out <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))
  out[nzchar(out)]
}

badge <- function(label, class = "") {
  if (is.na(label) || !nzchar(label)) return("")
  sprintf('<span class="badge-meta %s">%s</span>', class, esc(label))
}

all_keywords <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(df$`Code keywords`, split_tags))))

num <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x)
fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

today       <- Sys.Date()
first_all   <- suppressWarnings(min(as.Date(df$first_commit_date), na.rm = TRUE))
span_days   <- as.numeric(today - first_all)

# How recently a package has been touched drives the card's accent colour.
activity <- function(last) {
  if (is.na(last)) return(list(cls = "unknown", label = "", ago = ""))
  d <- as.numeric(today - as.Date(last))
  ago <- if (d < 1) "today" else if (d < 2) "yesterday" else if (d < 60) sprintf("%d days ago", d)
         else if (d < 700) sprintf("%d months ago", round(d / 30.4)) else sprintf("%d years ago", round(d / 365))
  list(cls   = if (d <= 90) "active" else if (d <= 365) "maintained" else "dormant",
       label = if (d <= 90) "Active" else if (d <= 365) "Maintained" else "Dormant",
       ago   = ago)
}

stat <- function(label, value, title = NULL, primary = FALSE) {
  if (is.na(value)) return("")
  sprintf('<div class="stat%s"%s><dd>%s</dd><dt>%s</dt></div>',
          if (primary) " is-primary" else "",
          if (is.null(title)) "" else sprintf(' title="%s"', esc(title)),
          fmt_n(value), esc(label))
}

# A bar placed on a shared time axis, so a package's age and recency can be
# compared across the whole catalogue at a glance.
lifespan_html <- function(r) {
  if (is.na(r$first_commit_date) || is.na(r$last_commit_date) || span_days <= 0) return("")
  f <- as.Date(r$first_commit_date); l <- as.Date(r$last_commit_date)
  left  <- as.numeric(f - first_all) / span_days * 100
  width <- max(as.numeric(l - f) / span_days * 100, 1.5)
  sprintf('<div class="lifespan" title="First commit %s, last commit %s">
             <div class="lifespan-track"><span class="lifespan-bar" style="left:%.1f%%;width:%.1f%%"></span></div>
             <div class="lifespan-dates"><span>Started %s</span><span>Last commit %s</span></div>
           </div>', f, l, left, width, format(f, "%b %Y"), format(l, "%d %b %Y"))
}

stats_html <- function(r) {
  items <- paste0(
    stat("GitHub stars", r$github_stars, primary = TRUE),
    stat("CRAN downloads / month", r$cran_downloads_last_month, "CRAN downloads in the last 30 days (cranlogs)", primary = TRUE),
    stat("CRAN downloads total", r$cran_downloads_total, "Total CRAN downloads since 2012-10-01 (cranlogs)"),
    stat("Contributors", r$contributors),
    stat("Owner followers", r$github_followers, "Followers of the owning GitHub user/organisation")
  )
  if (!nzchar(items)) return("")
  sprintf('<dl class="entry-stats">%s</dl>', items)
}

build_card <- function(i) {
  r    <- df[i, ]
  name <- derive_name(r$`Software website`)
  ck   <- split_tags(r$`Code keywords`)
  tk   <- split_tags(r$`Topic keywords`)

  title_html <- if (!is.na(name) && !is.na(r$`Software website`)) {
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
            esc(r$`Software website`), esc(name))
  } else {
    esc(name %||% r$`Code type`)
  }

  haystack <- tolower(paste(
    name, r$`Code maintainer`, r$Organisation, r$Description,
    paste(ck, collapse = " "), paste(tk, collapse = " "),
    r$Language, r$License, r$`Code type`
  ))

  tags_html <- if (length(tk)) {
    paste0('<ul class="entry-tags">',
           paste0(sprintf('<li>%s</li>', esc(tk)), collapse = ""),
           '</ul>')
  } else ""

  act <- activity(r$last_commit_date)
  status_html <- if (nzchar(act$label)) {
    sprintf('<span class="status is-%s" title="Last commit %s">%s <span class="status-ago">· %s</span></span>',
            act$cls, esc(r$last_commit_date), act$label, act$ago)
  } else ""
  cran_badge <- if (!is.na(r$cran_package)) badge("On CRAN", "is-cran") else ""

  sprintf(
    '<article class="entry is-%s" data-search="%s" data-keywords="%s"
              data-name="%s" data-stars="%s" data-downloads="%s" data-updated="%s">
       <header class="entry-head">
         <h3 class="entry-name">%s</h3>
         <div class="entry-badges">%s%s%s%s</div>
         %s
       </header>
       <p class="entry-by">%s <span class="sep">/</span> %s</p>
       <p class="entry-desc">%s</p>
       %s
       %s
       %s
       <p class="entry-links"><a href="mailto:%s">Contact maintainer</a></p>
     </article>',
    act$cls,
    esc(haystack),
    esc(tolower(paste(ck, collapse = "|"))),
    esc(tolower(name)),
    num(r$github_stars) %|na|% -1,
    num(r$cran_downloads_total) %|na|% -1,
    if (is.na(r$last_commit_date)) 0 else as.numeric(as.Date(r$last_commit_date)),
    title_html,
    badge(r$Language, "is-lang"),
    badge(r$License, "is-license"),
    badge(r$`Code type`),
    cran_badge,
    status_html,
    esc(r$`Code maintainer`),
    esc(r$Organisation),
    esc(r$Description),
    stats_html(r),
    lifespan_html(r),
    tags_html,
    esc(r$Email)
  )
}

`%|na|%` <- function(a, b) if (is.na(a)) b else a

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a)) b else a

cards_html <- paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), build_card, character(1)), collapse = "\n")

chips_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<button type="button" class="chip facet-chip" data-key="%s" aria-pressed="false"><span class="chip-label">%s</span><span class="chip-n" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>',
          esc(tolower(all_keywords)), esc(all_keywords)),
  collapse = ""
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# A raw fence stops pandoc reading the indented HTML below as markdown code.
cat('```{=html}\n')
cat(sprintf('
<div class="db-controls">
  <label class="visually-hidden" for="db-search">Search the database</label>
  <input id="db-search" class="db-search" type="search" autocomplete="off"
         placeholder="Search by package, author, keyword or description…">
  <button type="button" class="filter-btn" id="db-filter-btn"
          aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="db-filters">
    <svg class="filter-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 4h12M4 8h8M6.5 12h3"/></svg>
    <span>Filters</span>
    <span class="filter-badge" id="db-filter-n" hidden></span>
  </button>
  <div class="db-sort">
    <label for="db-sort">Sort by</label>
    <select id="db-sort">
      <option value="updated" selected>Recently updated</option>
      <option value="name">Name</option>
      <option value="stars">GitHub stars</option>
      <option value="downloads">CRAN downloads</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <p class="db-count-line"><strong id="db-count">%d</strong> of %d entries</p>

  <div class="filter-panel" id="db-filters" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="db-fp-title" hidden>
    <div class="fp-head">
      <h2 class="fp-title" id="db-fp-title">Filters</h2>
      <button type="button" class="fp-close" id="db-filters-close" aria-label="Close filters">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="fp-body">
      <section class="facet" role="group" aria-labelledby="db-f-kw">
        <h3 class="facet-label" id="db-f-kw">Code keyword</h3>
        <div class="facet-chips">%s</div>
      </section>
    </div>
    <div class="fp-foot">
      <button type="button" class="chip chip-clear" id="db-clear" hidden>Clear all</button>
      <button type="button" class="fp-show" id="db-show">Show entries</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="db-active" id="db-active" aria-label="Active filters" hidden></div>

<div class="db-results">
%s
</div>

<p class="db-empty" id="db-empty" hidden>No entries match that search. Try a broader term or clear the filters.</p>
', nrow(df), nrow(df), chips_html, cards_html))
cat('\n```\n')
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const input  = document.getElementById('db-search');
  const chips  = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.facet-chip'));
  const clear  = document.getElementById('db-clear');
  const cards  = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.entry'));
  const count  = document.getElementById('db-count');
  const empty  = document.getElementById('db-empty');
  const active = new Set();
  const sortSel = document.getElementById('db-sort');
  const list    = document.querySelector('.db-results');
  const filterBtn   = document.getElementById('db-filter-btn');
  const panel       = document.getElementById('db-filters');
  const badge       = document.getElementById('db-filter-n');
  const showBtn     = document.getElementById('db-show');
  const activeList  = document.getElementById('db-active');

  const entries = n => n === 1 ? '1 entry' : `${n} entries`;
  const cardKeys = card => (card.dataset.keywords || '').split('|').filter(Boolean);
  const matchesText = (card, term) => !term || (card.dataset.search || '').includes(term);

  // Numeric sorts run high-to-low; name runs A-Z. Entries with no value
  // (stored as -1 / 0) naturally sink to the bottom.
  function sortCards() {
    const key = sortSel.value;
    cards.sort((a, b) => key === 'name'
      ? a.dataset.name.localeCompare(b.dataset.name)
      : (Number(b.dataset[key]) - Number(a.dataset[key])) || a.dataset.name.localeCompare(b.dataset.name));
    cards.forEach(c => list.appendChild(c));
  }
  sortSel.addEventListener('change', sortCards);

  function setChip(chip, on) {
    if (on) { active.add(chip.dataset.key); } else { active.delete(chip.dataset.key); }
    chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
  }

  // Each chip shows how many entries it would match with the current search.
  function updateChips(term) {
    chips.forEach(chip => {
      const n = cards.filter(card => matchesText(card, term) && cardKeys(card).includes(chip.dataset.key)).length;
      const on = active.has(chip.dataset.key);
      chip.querySelector('.chip-n').textContent = n;
      chip.disabled = n === 0 && !on;
      chip.setAttribute('aria-label', `${chip.querySelector('.chip-label').textContent}, ${entries(n)}`);
    });
  }

  // Removable pills for the keywords that are on, so they stay visible
  // with the panel closed.
  function showActive() {
    const on = chips.filter(chip => active.has(chip.dataset.key));
    activeList.replaceChildren();
    on.forEach(chip => {
      const label = chip.querySelector('.chip-label').textContent;
      const pill = document.createElement('button');
      pill.type = 'button';
      pill.className = 'chip active-pill';
      pill.setAttribute('aria-label', `Remove filter: ${label}`);
      pill.append(label);
      const cross = document.createElement('span');
      cross.className = 'x';
      cross.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      cross.textContent = '×';
      pill.append(cross);
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => { setChip(chip, false); apply(); });
      activeList.append(pill);
    });
    if (on.length > 1) {
      const all = document.createElement('button');
      all.type = 'button';
      all.className = 'active-clear';
      all.textContent = 'Clear all';
      all.addEventListener('click', clearAll);
      activeList.append(all);
    }
    activeList.hidden = on.length === 0;
  }

  function apply() {
    const term = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    let shown = 0;
    cards.forEach(card => {
      // OR within the facet: any selected keyword is enough to match.
      const okChip = active.size === 0 || cardKeys(card).some(k => active.has(k));
      const show = matchesText(card, term) && okChip;
      card.hidden = !show;
      if (show) shown++;
    });
    count.textContent = shown;
    empty.hidden = shown !== 0;

    updateChips(term);
    showActive();
    badge.hidden = active.size === 0;
    badge.textContent = active.size;
    filterBtn.classList.toggle('is-active', active.size > 0);
    filterBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', active.size ? `Filters, ${active.size} active` : 'Filters');
    showBtn.textContent = shown === 0 ? 'No matches' : `Show ${entries(shown)}`;
    showBtn.disabled = shown === 0;
    clear.hidden = active.size === 0;
  }

  function clearAll() {
    chips.forEach(chip => setChip(chip, false));
    apply();
  }

  function setPanel(open, returnFocus = true) {
    panel.hidden = !open;
    filterBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) {
      (panel.querySelector('.facet-chip:not(:disabled)') || panel.querySelector('.fp-close')).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    } else if (returnFocus) {
      filterBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
  }

  filterBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setPanel(panel.hidden));
  document.getElementById('db-filters-close').addEventListener('click', () => setPanel(false));
  showBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setPanel(false));

  // Clicking anywhere else closes the panel, without pulling focus back.
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    if (panel.hidden || panel.contains(e.target) || filterBtn.contains(e.target)) return;
    setPanel(false, false);
  }, true);

  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !panel.hidden) setPanel(false);
  });

  input.addEventListener('input', apply);

  chips.forEach(chip => chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
    setChip(chip, !active.has(chip.dataset.key));
    apply();
  }));

  clear.addEventListener('click', clearAll);

  // Allow the landing page to deep-link a search or a keyword.
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const q = params.get('q');
  if (q) input.value = q;
  const k = (params.get('k') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (k) {
    const chip = chips.find(c => c.dataset.key === k);
    if (chip) { active.add(k); chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); }
  }
  sortCards();
  apply();
})();
</script>
```
